title: Metadata & artwork
lead: Keys are stored on this PC only and used with the services below. Fields save as you type, and each key is checked with its service as soon as you enter it.

refresh.allStarted: Refreshing metadata and artwork for every game
refresh.missingStarted: Fetching metadata for games that have none
refresh.failed: Could not start the metadata refresh
refresh.missingQueued_one: Looking for missing art for {count} game…
refresh.missingQueued_other: Looking for missing art for {count} games…
refresh.needsSignIn: Covers need a SteamGridDB, ScreenScraper or IGDB sign-in. Add one in Settings › Metadata.

artSourceNeeded: Covers for games the stores have no art for need a SteamGridDB, ScreenScraper, IGDB or TheGamesDB sign-in below. Once one is added, the missing covers are looked for automatically.

autoScrape.label: Scrape automatically
autoScrape.description: Fetch metadata and artwork for new games right after a scan.

localArt.label: Use art from installed store clients
localArt.description: Reuse covers that Steam, GOG Galaxy and Epic already downloaded to this PC before fetching anything.

hltb.label: HowLongToBeat times
hltb.description: Look up main story / completionist times (one query per game, cached 30 days).

steamTags.label: Steam tags
steamTags.description: Read Steam's player tags (Roguelike, Souls-like, ...) for every game, including other stores' games that are also on Steam.

region.label: Preferred region
region.description: Which regional release, title and box art to prefer for ROMs.

use.label: Use the PlayOut database
use.description: Fill each game's release date, genres, tags, developers, publishers and local players from the shared PlayOut database before asking the scrapers.

contribute.label: Add missing games to the database
contribute.description: Send the title and facts of games the database lacks, with an anonymous install id; nothing personal and never your own edits.

steamgriddb.note: Covers, heroes and logos. Sign in to SteamGridDB, then generate a key under Preferences › API.

igdb.note: Descriptions, genres and release dates, and the user rating shown for games without a Steam review score. Register an application on the Twitch developer console, then copy its client ID and generate a client secret.

screenscraper.note: ROM metadata and artwork by file hash. The developer ID and password are required (ScreenScraper issues them on its forum); a user account raises the daily quota.

thegamesdb.note: Box art and descriptions. Sign in to TheGamesDB to see your API key.

steam.note: Achievements and play time from the Steam Web API. Your SteamID64 is the 17-digit number on your profile.
